revision.note: Slots rewritten from animal-coded human performers to photoreal CGI animals.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027): 'the talking crowd of little animals and birds'

composition.note: Every member of this crowd is a CGI animal. The humans at this location have their own cards: Pat (CHAR-pat, human performer) and, off-screen, the voices already assigned to named characters.

rendering.limits: Natural anatomy per species; no clothing. Props (ladders, rope, barrow, bottle) are handled only as far as the animal's body allows.

heavy_prop_staging.proposal: The two tied ladders and the barrow of pebbles are handled by Pat (human, own card) with the animals clustering and helping: birds tug the rope from the roof by beak, the stoat and rabbit shove the barrow. No animal carries a ladder on two legs. Final staging belongs to 07-directing.

scope.on_screen: ch004 only: the crowd of little animals and birds outside the White Rabbit's house, and those helping with the ladder and roof (ev0016-ev0017).
scope.ch006_chorus: Voice-only in this card. The ch006 'Wow! wow! wow!' chorus belongs to the cook and the baby joining the Duchess (ch006-p37); no crowd members appear in the kitchen (see DEF-p3-appearance-302).
scope.quote: CHORUS. (In which the cook and the baby joined):

headcount.note: Includes the two guinea-pigs holding up Bill (CHAR-bill-the-lizard, own card). The White Rabbit and Pat have their own cards.
headcount.quote: found quite a crowd of little animals and birds waiting outside. The poor little Lizard, Bill, was in the middle, being held up by two guinea-pigs, who were giving it something out of a bottle.

gender_note.reason: Mixed crowd; source gives no genders. Designed as a neighbourhood crew, male 6 / female 4 at full headcount. Gender matters for voices and, where the species differs by sex, plumage.

slots_reason: Source: 'little animals and birds' plus two guinea-pigs; all other species designed, avoiding species cast elsewhere. The guinea-pig recurrence with the jury is a designed dream echo (TERM-0036). The brandy bottle is held by the guinea-pigs (X01/X02), as in the source.

hair.value: species-natural; dusted with brick grime from the roof work

face.value: excited, flustered, chattering; they rush at Alice together
face.quote: They all made a rush at Alice the moment she appeared

build.body_type: species-true per slot; all 'little' (shrew smallest, rook and rabbit largest)
build.scale_reference: When Alice comes out she has just shrunk (ch004-p34) and is small, so the crowd is roughly at her scale. While she is inside and giant they are tiny figures below the window (SUP-003).

base_age_reason: Persona ages for voice casting only; all animals are adults of their species.

marks.description: from the roof slates, the ladders and the pebble barrow
marks.quote: Mind that loose slate—Oh, it’s coming down! Heads below!
marks.reason: Grime is a designed consequence of the sourced roof work.

signature_items.quote: Where’s the other ladder?—Why, I hadn’t to bring but one; Bill’s got the other

signature_items.item: a barrow of pebbles (the pebbles turn to little cakes, SUP-009)
signature_items.quote: A barrowful will do, to begin with.

signature_items.item: a small brandy bottle, tipped to Bill's mouth by the two guinea-pigs
signature_items.quote: who were giving it something out of a bottle

default_outfit_tone: none: no clothing on any member; natural earthy browns, blacks, greys and the robin's red

default_outfit_tone_source.reason: Per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old village working-dress reading is dropped; the text gives them no clothes.

variation_rules: X01/X02 are the same guinea-pig CGI assets as jury J01/J02.
No white animal in the crowd (white is reserved for the White Rabbit).
No card-suit devices: this is not the House of Hearts.
Nobody from this crowd appears in the Duchess's kitchen (ch006).

doubling.reason: Not part of any H1 ruling 5.3 B doubling pair.

prompt_summary_en: A crowd of photoreal little wild animals and birds outside a small cottage, rushing forward excitedly: two round piebald guinea-pigs holding up a limp small lizard and tipping a tiny bottle to its mouth, a brown agouti rabbit, a stoat, a tiny shrew, a robin, a song thrush, a dunnock, a rook and a jackdaw on the roof with a rope, two ladders tied together, a wheelbarrow of pebbles, dusty with brick grime, natural animal anatomy, no clothing, live-action film plate
